description: Add tags to up to 10 existing transcriptions at once — the tool for "label these interviews as Q3". Tags are created on first use, so they need not exist beforehand. Letters, digits and spaces only, at most 30 characters each; a transcription holds at most 5 tags and further ones are skipped rather than replacing existing tags. Passing more than 10 ids is refused, not truncated. Requires `login`.

tags.description: Tag names to add. Letters, digits and spaces, max 30 characters each.

transcription_ids.description: Transcription ids to tag. At most 10 per call.

name: tag_transcriptions
